crossRefs.note: King Rehoboam took counsel with the old men, who had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, “What…
With aged men is wisdom, in length of days understanding.
What do you know that we don’t know? What do you understand which is not in us?
With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much elder than your father.
Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job, because they were elder than he.
Therefore I said, ‘Listen to me; I also will show my opinion.’
The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures…
To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’ ”
“ ‘How do you say, “We are wise, and Yahweh’s law is with us?” But, behold, the false pen of the scribes has made that…
The wise men are disappointed. They are dismayed and trapped. Behold, they have rejected Yahweh’s word. What kind of…
“Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine, and does them, I will liken him to a wise man, who built his house…
Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of…

translations.web: I understand more than the aged, because I have kept your precepts.
translations.bsb: I discern more than the elders, for I obey Your precepts.
translations.kjv: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.
translations.asv: I understand more than the aged, Because I have kept thy precepts.
